name: Better than yesterday
definition: 1% better each day, 5 days a week, is 11x better a year. We take small gains every day, even if big ones are 'just around the corner'. In that way, we build towards the highest standards, and achieve goals many think are impossible.

rows.under: We don't bother making simple improvements to our products, processes and workspaces. We find that we are doing the same grind one year to the next.
rows.justRight: We take every opportunity to improve without jeopardizing key deliverables. We achieve gains on a daily basis and celebrate when others make even small improvements.
rows.over: We spend so much time improving that we miss key deadlines.
